name: Figma AI
tagline: AI design assistant built into Figma for generating UI layouts, renaming layers, and auto-layout.
definition: Figma AI is an integrated suite of generative features embedded directly in the Figma canvas. It allows UI/UX designers to generate initial UI component layouts from text prompts, automatically rename messy layers, replace text copy, and apply auto-layout constraints.
why_it_matters: By integrating AI directly into the dominant professional UI design tool, Figma AI removes tedious wireframing and layer organization tasks from product designers' daily workflows.
workplace_use_cases: Generating initial mobile application wireframes and UI components from text briefs
Automatically organizing and renaming messy canvas layers and frame hierarchies
Replacing placeholder text with contextually accurate UI microcopy
Removing backgrounds from user avatar photos directly on the design canvas
how_to_use: Open any Figma canvas, click the Figma AI action button in the toolbar, select 'Make a design', enter a prompt (e.g. 'Build a settings page for a iOS health app'), and iterate.
key_features: Generates editable UI frames complete with design system components
Automated layer renaming and layer structure clean-up
Contextual visual search across design component libraries
Integrated visual background removal and image generation

pricing.free_tier_details: Included in standard Figma Free and Professional plans during beta.

paid_plans.name: Figma Professional
paid_plans.notes: Includes full Figma AI feature access and team component libraries.

paid_plans.name: Figma Organization
paid_plans.notes: Enterprise design systems and AI workspace security policies.

name: Framer AI
tagline: Generative website builder turning text prompts into published responsive web pages.
definition: Framer AI is a web design tool that converts text descriptions into fully responsive, published websites. It generates page layouts, custom color palettes, responsive CSS breakpoints, and interactive web animations on a canvas workspace.
why_it_matters: Framer AI bridged the gap between raw UI design and web publishing, enabling design teams to build and publish interactive marketing sites without writing HTML or CSS.
workplace_use_cases: Generating complete SaaS product landing pages from brief marketing descriptions
Iterating on site color palettes and typography pairings with one-click AI shuffle
Publishing responsive portfolio sites and campaign splash pages instantly
Creating web animations and page scroll effects without code
how_to_use: Visit framer.com, click 'Start with AI', prompt your site concept (e.g. 'Build a landing page for a fintech app featuring dark mode and pricing card'), and publish.
key_features: Text-to-website generation with fully responsive mobile/tablet breakpoints
One-click theme, font, and copy variation shuffling
Built-in CMS for blog posts and dynamic web content
Instant custom domain publishing and fast global CDN hosting

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan includes framer.website domain and basic site traffic.

paid_plans.name: Mini
paid_plans.notes: Custom domain, 1,000 visitors/month, basic landing page.

paid_plans.name: Basic
paid_plans.notes: 10,000 visitors/month, password protection, custom code integration.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: 200,000 visitors/month, full site analytics, staging environments.

name: Relume AI
tagline: AI site builder for generating sitemaps and wireframes exportable to Webflow and Figma.
definition: Relume AI is a site planning and wireframing assistant. Given a prompt, it generates complete website sitemaps and wireframe page layouts, which can be exported directly into Figma component libraries or Webflow projects.
why_it_matters: Relume streamlined web agency project scoping by automating sitemap architecture and low-fidelity wireframing before visual design begins.
workplace_use_cases: Generating sitemap structures and page briefs for complex corporate websites
Creating low-fidelity wireframe layouts for client web design pitches
Exporting wireframe components straight into Webflow for rapid site building
Syncing wireframe structures with team Figma component design systems
how_to_use: Go to relume.io, describe your company or website project, refine generated sitemap nodes, click 'Generate Wireframes', and export to Figma or Webflow.
key_features: AI Sitemap and page structure builder
Component-based wireframe generator (thousands of pre-built UI sections)
Direct one-click export to Figma and Webflow
Collaborative web agency client presentation mode

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan includes 1 project with 1 sitemap and 1 wireframe.

paid_plans.name: Starter
paid_plans.notes: 3 projects/month, full Figma and Webflow export.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited AI sitemaps and wireframes, team library access.

name: Uizard
tagline: AI-powered UI design and prototyping tool that converts hand-drawn sketches into editable wireframes.
definition: Uizard is an AI design platform that converts text prompts, paper wireframe sketches, and web screenshots into editable, interactive digital prototypes.
why_it_matters: Uizard democratized app wireframing, allowing non-designers to convert whiteboard sketches into functional UI prototypes in minutes.
workplace_use_cases: Converting paper wireframe sketches into digital mobile prototypes
Generating full application UI wireframes from text prompts
Creating interactive click-through prototypes for stakeholder demos
how_to_use: Sign in at uizard.io, upload a sketch or type a prompt, and edit generated UI wireframe screens.
key_features: Sketch-to-screen AI wireframe conversion
Text-to-UI screen generator
Autodesign 2.0 theme and component styling

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan includes 2 projects and 10 free AI generations.

paid_plans.name: Business
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited AI generations, custom design systems.

name: Visily
tagline: AI wireframing and UI prototyping tool engineered for software teams and product managers.
definition: Visily is an AI design tool that converts screenshots, templates, and text prompts into low and high-fidelity wireframes.
why_it_matters: Visily focuses specifically on product managers and developers needing fast, accessible wireframes without Figma's complexity.
workplace_use_cases: Converting app screenshots into editable wireframe components
Creating low-fidelity wireframes for user stories and PRDs
Collaborating on product user flow diagrams
how_to_use: Open visily.ai, select Screenshot-to-Design or Text-to-Design, and generate wireframes.
key_features: Screenshot to editable UI wireframe converter
Text to wireframe layout generator
Rich library of pre-built UI components

pricing.free_tier_details: Free access during public platform launch.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Advanced AI credits, team design libraries, export to code.

name: Galileo AI
tagline: Generative AI platform for creating editable UI designs from natural language prompts.
definition: Galileo AI is a generative UI tool that creates complex, multi-screen mobile and web interface designs from text prompts, exportable directly to Figma.
why_it_matters: Galileo AI generates high-fidelity UI screens complete with realistic microcopy and iconography.
workplace_use_cases: Generating full mobile application user flows from text briefs
Exporting generated UI screens into Figma component files
Exploring visual UI theme options
how_to_use: Visit usegalileo.ai, type a prompt (e.g. 'Build a food delivery checkout screen'), and export to Figma.
key_features: Generates high-fidelity mobile and web UI screens
Direct export to editable Figma layers and auto-layouts
Contextually accurate microcopy generation

name: Spline AI
tagline: 3D design platform with generative AI for creating, animating, and embedding interactive 3D assets.
definition: Spline AI is a 3D web design editor that uses generative prompts to create, texture, and animate 3D objects directly on a web canvas.
why_it_matters: Spline AI democratized 3D web design, enabling UI designers to embed interactive 3D elements into websites without complex Blender workflows.
workplace_use_cases: Generating 3D web assets and background objects from text prompts
Applying AI textures to 3D meshes on a web canvas
Embedding interactive 3D models into Framer or Webflow sites
how_to_use: Open spline.design, click Spline AI, enter a prompt (e.g. 'Create a glowing sci-fi cube'), and embed.
key_features: Text-to-3D object and texture generation
Real-time physics and interactivity controls
Direct export to WebGL, React, and HTML embed code

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan includes unlimited personal 3D files and basic AI credits.

paid_plans.name: Super
paid_plans.notes: Full AI features, export without watermark.

paid_plans.name: Team
paid_plans.notes: Shared 3D asset libraries and team folders.

name: Khroma
tagline: AI color palette generator trained on professional human designer preferences.
definition: Khroma is an AI color tool for designers that learns your color preferences and generates endless, harmonious color palettes, typography pairs, and gradients.
why_it_matters: Khroma uses neural networks trained on thousands of professional color combinations to personalize palette generation.
workplace_use_cases: Selecting personalized brand color palettes for UI design systems
Testing accessible typography contrast combinations
Generating custom dual-color gradients
how_to_use: Select 50 favorite colors at khroma.co to train the neural network, then browse generated palettes.
key_features: Personalized neural network color matching engine
Displays color pairs on typography, cards, and gradients
WCAG accessibility contrast score checking

pricing.free_tier_details: Free forever for all web users.

name: Genius by Diagram
tagline: AI design companion embedded in Figma for automated component generation and layout iteration.
definition: Genius (created by Diagram, acquired by Figma) is an AI design assistant plugin for Figma that suggests UI component iterations and autocompletes design frames.
why_it_matters: Genius brought predictive UI design autocompletion directly inside professional Figma design files.
workplace_use_cases: Autocompleting UI design frame layouts based on adjacent design system tokens
Generating custom UI icons and vector graphics in Figma
Writing UI microcopy
how_to_use: Install Diagram plugins in Figma, invoke Genius on a frame, and accept design suggestions.
key_features: Predictive UI design autocompletion
Direct integration with Figma design tokens and component libraries
AI vector graphic generation

pricing.free_tier_details: Free tier included with Figma account.

paid_plans.name: Diagram Pro
paid_plans.notes: Full access to Magician, Genius, and Automator Figma plugins.
